name: form
label: Subscription form
help_text: The HubSpot form this block submits to. Chosen from the dropdown - the module never asks for a raw GUID. Use an email-only form: this block collects just the email address, so a form with other required fields or a consent checkbox will be rejected. Point those at the /subscribe page instead. The form's confirmation message is shown inline on success. Leave blank to show a link to /subscribe rather than a signup field.

default.message: Thanks - you're subscribed to Weld Connect.

name: layout
label: Layout
help_text: Full-width banner (news listing and the foot of an article) or the narrow card used in the article sidebar.

name: body_text
label: Body text
default: Subscribe to Weld Connect for practical updates on welding standards, technical resources, training, events and industry policy.

name: error_message
label: Error message
help_text: Shown under the signup if the subscription cannot be recorded. A link to the /subscribe page is appended automatically.
default: Something went wrong. Please try again, or subscribe from our subscribe page.
